name: La Cierva (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, crimson at the hoist and white at the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Cierva (a deer, a tree, tools and a mountain).
history: Municipal flag of La Cierva; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Cierva arms — deer, tree, tools and mountain
